title: Project
description: A working session that binds a Cohort to a Protocol and assigns user roles. Annotations and InferenceRuns reference a Project for context. Projects are versioned the same way as other documents — to add a member, write a new Project document with predecessor pointing at the old one.

description.description: Markdown description: research goal, principal investigator, any LNQ-team-specific context.

cohort_id.description: Reference to a Cohort document. Projects pin a specific Cohort version; if the cohort is re-versioned, the Project must also be re-versioned to follow.

protocol_id.description: Reference to a Protocol document. Same versioning discipline as cohort_id.

members.description: Project membership. At least one member must have role 'admin'.

role.description: admin: can re-version the project, manage membership. annotator: can write Annotations against this project. reviewer: can write ComparisonReports and Comments referencing this project.
